WITH patient_averages AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB) AS overall_avg_hgb
    FROM Laboratory
), above_average AS (
    SELECT pa.ID, pa.avg_hgb, oa.overall_avg_hgb
    FROM patient_averages pa
    CROSS JOIN overall_average oa
    WHERE pa.avg_hgb > oa.overall_avg_hgb
)
SELECT ID,
       avg_hgb,
       avg_hgb - overall_avg_hgb AS above_overall_average,
       avg_hgb - AVG(avg_hgb) OVER () AS difference_from_above_average_group
FROM above_average
ORDER BY difference_from_above_average_group DESC
LIMIT 10;
